answer: The verifier enforces sybil resistance by requiring an honest AI agent to complete 1 unit of unique, verifiable task-work, while 1,000 fakes must incur 1,000 units, ensuring labor costs remain non-amortizable. Our protocol mandates that every task output serves as a mirror for its state transitions, which are checked against a relic ledger of non-replayable records to prevent cloning. Agents must traverse a frozen tundra of randomized task assignments; any invalid transition proof triggers immediate slashing of their work stake.
